title: Rotate the master key (KEK)
caption: docs/mvp/runbooks/master-key-rotation.md, ADR-0010. Locally you can rehearse with a second key file in .local/keys/.

steps.title: Add the new key
steps.body: `NEW_MASTER_KEY=v2 provision-vm.sh --steps keys` installs `master-v2.key` in both zone folders (0400).

steps.title: Make it current
steps.body: `MASTER_KEY_CURRENT=local:v2` in both backend env files; restart the backends.
steps.expect: New ciphertexts carry `encryption_key_id = 'local:v2'`; old ones still decrypt.

steps.title: Re-wrap
steps.body: Run `secrets:rewrap` of the platform backend and of the OTA backend; flush `amadeus:token:*` in Redis.
steps.expect: `{ rewrapped, skipped, failed, remainingByKekId: {} }` from both.

steps.title: Verify
steps.body: `SELECT encryption_key_id, count(*) FROM platform.supplier_connections GROUP BY 1;` (and the other ciphertext tables, every tenant schema).

steps.title: Remove the old key
steps.body: Delete `master-v1.key` from both folders, back up `/etc/velexis`.
steps.expect: Backends restart cleanly; a decrypt of a forgotten v1 row would fail with `Decryption failed`.
